segments.text: So yun po yung mga nakikita namin, pwede namin gawing immediately at kahit pa paano po, maibsan naman po yung mga pasanin ng ating mga motorista.

segments.text: So ito na lang po yung naiiwan na option.

segments.text: Kaya minabuti na rin po namin nakiusap sa NLEX management.

segments.text: Kung maaari, itol free natin yung segment ng Pulilan hanggang San Fernando and vice versa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.text: service contracting ng EDSA Bus Carousel, ng PTMP.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Pero minabuti po ng Kongreso na bigyan kami ng pondo dito sa mga ganitong programa.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: At ang nangyari po because of oil crisis.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Nagamit namin yung mga programang nilaan ninyo ng pondo.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Ganito din po ang sitwasyon namin sa EDSA bus carousel.

segments.text: Ang dati-dati po ang sinasabi po nila.

segments.text: Ang maaaring rason kung bakit hindi kami nabibigyan ng tamang budget sa aming inihingi.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Ay una yung limited fiscal space.

segments.text: Pangalawa sabi po nila baka po yung obligation rate po namin at yung BOR.

segments.text: Ang obligation rate na po ng DOTR.

segments.text: So mapakikita naman natin na yung yung rason na yun ay talagang sinusolusyonan namin at tinutuganan.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Mr. Chair, unang-una po yung Memorandum of Agreement na naka-integrate na po yung permit to enter doon sa mga Villar property.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: And then, kailangan na rin po namin makakuha ng permit to enter doon sa mga iba pang lupa na kailangan po nung stasyon.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: At ito po yung ginagawa na po namin ngayon kasi mga naunang panahon po,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: hindi po kami masyadong ini-entertain ng mga lot owners kasi nga po,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: wala pang kasiguraduhan kung matutuloy nga po yung donasyon ng Villar Group.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: So, ngayong meron na pong kaliwanagan,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: willing na po sila na i-entertain po kami at mamadalin po namin na makakuha po kami ng,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: matapos po namin yung tinatawag natin ng negotiated procurement

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: at makakuha kami kaagad po ng permit to enter para maisakatuparan po namin yung kasunod na hakbangin.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Ang una po dito is una po, yun nga yung ma-acquire po namin or makapasok kami doon sa property

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: and then pangalawang step po nito,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: is maisagawa po namin yung mga demolition activities kasi may mga structures po doon,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: kailangan po natin i-demolish ito para ma-turnover po natin doon sa concessionaire.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: At mamadalin po namin lahat po itong mga hakbangin na ito para makabilis po natin yung timeline ng project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, kung sinasabing resolved na ang right-of-way issue,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: maaari po ba ninyong kumpirmahin sa komiting ito na wala nang natitirang legal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: technical, financial or property issues na maaaring muling madelay sa proyekto?

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Mr. Chair, so far po doon sa naging usapan namin with the Villar Group

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: and po doon sa report ng PMO, wala na pong technical at financial issues po

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: na pwedeng humadlang po dito sa usapin tungkol sa lokasyon ng Las Piñas Station.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yung nakasanla po kasing property, na-resolve na po ba yun?

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Opo, Mr. Chair, based po doon sa usapan namin with the senior executives po ng Villar Group,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: very confident po sila na ma-approve po yung pagkakataon,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Ang ginawa po nila is nag-offer po sila ng kapalit na property.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: At yun po, hinihintay na lang po yung formal approval.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Kaya nga po, very, very confident po sila na within September,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: ma-re-release na po yung dalawang property na yun.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Kaya nga po, willing na po silang pumirma.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Anytime po, at upon signing nga po,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: naka-integrate na po doon sa memorandum of agreement na after 30 days,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: pwede na po namin pasukin at gamitin po yung property.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Kailan po eksaktong magsisimula ang aktuwal na konstruksyon sa Las Piñas Station?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Hindi po general timeline ang hihingin po natin ay target date.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yung target date po, kailangan po namin i-calibrate.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Sabi ko nga po, number one, tapusin lang po na namin yung documentation

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: ng mga properties na kailangan po natin sa property.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Makakuha kami ng formal permit to enter sa mga properties na ito.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: And then, umpisan po namin yung demolition.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Kailangan po namin i-subject ng procurement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may, yung estimate niyo po, Las Peñas Station, gano'ng katagal po?

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Sa estimate po, mga halos mga three years pa po.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Isasama na po yung demolition, yung acquisition po,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: and then, iti-design pa po ito nung ating concessionaire,

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: and then, actual po, nagagawin po nila yung station.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: We have to remember po, Mr. Chair, na ang gagawa po nito ay yung concessionaire.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: So, kukuha pa rin po sila ng designer po nila

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: yung design nung stasyon at saka yung biodeck.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Then, at the same time, kukuha po sila ng kanilang contractor.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: So, doon pa lang po, actually, mga kapag umpisa.

segments.speaker: LRTA Administrator Atty. Hernando T. Cabrera
segments.text: Kaya, we're estimating po, mga, mga, mga, almost mga three years pa po or more.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: To Secretary Lopez, ilang taon na pong naghihintay ang mga commuter ng Las Peñas at Cavite.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Ilang beses na rin pong narinig ng publiko na malapit na ma-resolve.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Magsisimula na ang proyekto. Ngayon po, gusto nating maging malinaw.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At sino po ang mananagot kung muli na namang hindi ito matutupad, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kaya patuloy din po ako huhingi sa inyo na patuloy po kayong bantayan kami.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: At yung una pong usapan namin dito eh, sana po masimulan na namin makapasok sa property.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Ang target ko sana dito is first week of September.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Pero tulad nga po nang sinabi ni Admin Cabrera,

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: pinapapalitan kasi namin yung mga nakamortgage dito sa Las Piñas para naman protektado ang ating gobyerno.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kasama dyan yung unconditional permit to enter.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So yan naman po ay nakakuha ako ng commitment po sa kanila na hopefully this month matapos na po yung pirmahan.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Right after po ng pagpipirma, sabi ko isama na rin ng LRMC.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kasi ang talaga po magtatayo dito,

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: yung sinasabi nating proponent natin, LRMC.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: At pumayag naman po sila na masimulan itong Las Peñas Station.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Pag meron na silang permit to enter ay sisimulan na nila yung mga earthworks po nila doon sa estasyon na yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Meron pong 50 families na madi-dislocate or mare-relocate dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Ito po ay mga awardees na ng NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At nangangamba po sila na ano po ang mangyayari sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Kasi na-relocate na po sila, i-re-relocate na naman po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Ako po willing tumulong sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Pero kailangan bigyan po natin sila ng sapat na panahon para makapaghanda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At kung pwede niyong umpisahan yung mga posted doon sa sukat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: siguro ihuli muna natin sila at bigyan natin sila ng financial.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Of course na just compensation naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At the ARO law dictates that it's a fair market value ng lupa na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At tutulong po ako kasi meron po akong budget sa NHA for a socialized housing project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At hindi ko po pwedeng sabihin sa inyo kung saan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: So, I can sit down with you anytime po, Secretary and LRTA, Tornie Cabrera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Secretary, ang sinasabing solusyon ng right-of-way problem ay may pagdodonate ng lupa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Maaari po bang malinaw na sabihin ng committee na finalized na ang donation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Pero sinagot niyo na po kanina yan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Maaari po bang bigyan natin ang committing ito ng taga Las Piñas at ng isang malinaw na commitment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Matutuloy na ba talaga ang Las Piñas sa Pote at Nyog Stations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At kailan natin makikita ng may actual construction sa site?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Secretary, pagod na pagod na po ang aming mga commuter sa mga pangako.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At hinihingi nila ngayon ay hindi pangako, kundi action, timeline, at risulta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: I fully support the Las Piñas Station.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Salamat po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Salamat po, Mr. Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Makikipag-ugnayan po kami sa inyo, Cong Santos, at kailangan po talaga namin yung tulong

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: pagdating po dito sa mga sinasabi nating pamilya, 55 families na nasa tabi po nung Villar property.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: At yun din po yung sinabi natin sa LRTA, na unahin po yung Villar property.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Bibigyan po natin ang sapat na panahon, hindi lang po yung sapat na panahon.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Kung anong pang mga financial obligation, under the ARO Act po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: At magagawa lang po namin ito kung kasama po kayo, Cong Santos.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Pangalawa po, masasabi ko po talaga na once okay na po itong ating Las Piñas Station,

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: by way of formal document, deed of donation, ituloy-tuloy na po ang proyektong ito.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: We commit that po, not only the Las Piñas, kasi kailangan po natin i-address also yung Zapote,

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: na wala na pong problema, kaso lang po because of the Las Piñas, nagaantay na rin po sila.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: And all the way po, pagdating po sa Cavite.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Sek, kailangan po yung local government din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Upuan po natin yung [unclear], yung [unclear], para bigyan naman natin ng assurance yung mga kababayan ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Kasi po, pinanganak po sila doon mga 50, 60 years ago na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Tagaroon po ako sa lugar e, kaya kilala ko po silang lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Well, anyway, I have your assurance, Sek.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At sana hindi na tayo umabot sa susunod na budget hearing para at least naumpisa na po ang Las Piñas Station.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair and this committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mark Anthony G. Santos
segments.text: At malaking bagay po ito para sa mga taga-Las Piñas. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Thank you, Cong Mark. We'll have a one-hour lunch break.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edwin Ongchuan
segments.text: Kinabahan nyo yung iba, one minute na.
